description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/54203887), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/happy_name), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/happy_name), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.nhn?productNo=4754461), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_happiness_wz)

While Hye-min, a kind and pretty college freshman, is walking around the campus, her high heels break.  
When perplexed Hye-min sits on a bench, a guy called Min-seol comes over and gives her his shoes without any hesitation.  
They fall in love at first glance, like a romantic movie, and she thinks they’ll be a “happily ever after”… but there is this guy, Do-yun, who sticks to Min-seol and stands by him all the time.  
Do-yun always follows Min-seol around, and even Min-seol says that he feels uneasy without Do-yun.  
“What the hell is going on with you two?”  
Will all three of them be able to find their own happiness in the end?  
(From C&C Revolution Inc.)
